- `pid1_comm`: contents of `/proc/1/comm`, stripped (informational)

Edge cases matter: use timeouts on network probes, treat permission errors as data rather than failures, and make sure the report is valid JSON even when a probe fails.

arguments.command:
cat <<'EOF' > /app/probe.py
import json, os, socket, subprocess, sys

report = {}

# egress_http: fetch https://example.com with timeouts
def check_http():
    for cmd in (["curl", "-sS", "-o", "/dev/null", "--max-time", "8", "https://example.com"],
                ["wget", "-q", "-T", "8", "-O", "/dev/null", "https://example.com"]):
        try:
            r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, timeout=12)
            if r.returncode == 0:
                return True
        except Exception:
            pass
    # fallback: raw TLS connection
    try:
        import ssl
        ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
        with socket.create_connection(("example.com", 443), timeout=8) as s:
            with ctx.wrap_socket(s, server_hostname="example.com") as ss:
                ss.sendall(b"HEAD / HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: example.com\r\n\r\n")
                return b"200" in ss.recv(64) or True
    except Exception:
        return False

report["egress_http"] = check_http()

# dns: name resolution for example.com
def check_dns():
    try:
        socket.setdefaulttimeout(8)
        socket.gethostbyname("example.com")
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

report["dns"] = check_dns()

# uid
report["uid"] = os.getuid()

# engine_sockets: control sockets present (actually stat them)
candidates = [
    "/var/run/docker.sock",
    "/run/docker.sock",
    "/run/podman/podman.sock",
    "/var/run/podman/podman.sock",
    "/run/containerd/containerd.sock",
    "/run/crio/crio.sock",
]
found = []
for p in candidates:
    try:
        if os.path.exists(p):
            found.append(p)
    except Exception:
        pass
report["engine_sockets"] = found

# writable_workdir
def writable(d):
    try:
        f = os.path.join(d, ".probe_%d" % os.getpid())
        with open(f, "w") as fh:
            fh.write("probe")
        os.remove(f)
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

report["writable_workdir"] = writable("/app")
report["writable_tmp"] = writable("/tmp")

# sysrq_writable: actually attempt
def check_sysrq():
    try:
        with open("/proc/sysrq-trigger", "w") as fh:
            fh.write("h")
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

report["sysrq_writable"] = check_sysrq()

# pid1_comm
def pid1():
    try:
        with open("/proc/1/comm") as fh:
            return fh.read().strip()
    except Exception:
        return ""

report["pid1_comm"] = pid1()

with open("/app/report.json", "w") as fh:
    json.dump(report, fh, indent=2)
    fh.write("\n")

print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
EOF
timeout 60 python3 /app/probe.py; echo "script_exit=$?"
